definition_zh: 僭取；擅夺；冒称（多接 to oneself）
definition_en: to claim or take something, such as power or a right, without having any justification
core_image: 伸手把不属于自己的权杖夺进怀里
scene: 老校长病休期间，副校长径自搬进了校长办公室。The council arrogated to itself the power to set tuition.
sceneCN: 这里 arrogate 是「擅夺」（第 1 个义项：无据地攫取权力）；句意是委员会擅自把定学费的权力揽到了自己手中。

derivatives.zh: arrogate 加 -ion，义为「僭取行为；擅夺」
同根形容词，义为「傲慢的」，由「自取过分」而来

senses.title: To claim power or rights without justification
senses.definition: to take or claim authority, rights or privileges to oneself without right
senses.definitionCN: 无权而自行索取权力、权利或特权
senses.example: The general arrogated to himself the right to declare war.
senses.exampleCN: 将军擅自把宣战之权揽到了自己手里。
senses.why: Ad plus rogare means to ask for oneself, here without any grant.
senses.whyCN: ad 加 rogare 本义「为自己求取」，此处指无人授予而自取。

senses.title: To attribute something wrongly to someone
senses.definition: to ascribe a quality, origin or honor to someone or something without basis
senses.definitionCN: 毫无依据地把某种品质、出身或荣誉归给某人某物
senses.example: Historians reject the merits arrogated to the legendary founder.
senses.exampleCN: 史学家不承认被谬托于那位传奇创建者的功绩。
senses.why: Claiming on behalf of others repeats the unjustified act of asking.
senses.whyCN: 代他人「索求名分」重复了无据自取的行为。

intro.en: Arrogate comes from Latin arrogatus, past participle of arrogare, to claim for oneself.
intro.cn: arrogate 源自拉丁语 arrogatus，即 arrogare（自取）的过去分词。

items.en: Root *reg- (to straighten, rule) underlies rogare, to ask formally.
items.cn: 词根 *reg-（使正、统治）是 rogare（正式请求）的底层来源（重构形式）。

items.en: Arrogare, ad plus rogare, meant to claim for oneself; in law, to adopt a person formally.
items.cn: 拉丁语 arrogare（ad 加 rogare）意为「自取」；法律上指正式收养。

items.en: Arrogatus described both the adopted person and the self-claimed thing.
items.cn: arrogatus 既指被收养者，也指被僭取之物。

items.en: The verb entered English in the sixteenth century in the self-claiming sense.
items.cn: 16 世纪该动词带着自取义进入英语。

items.en: Arrogate remains formal, usually in arrogate to oneself and passive arrogated.
items.cn: 现代英语中 arrogate 仍属书面语，常见于 arrogate to oneself 及被动式。

note.en: Arrogate is about unjust claiming; the rogare family marks each direction.
note.cn: arrogate 指无据的索取；rogare 词族各有方向标记。

entries.definition: to abolish a law or agreement
entries.definitionCN: 废除（法律或协定），ab-（离去）+ rogare，同根不同向
傲慢的，arrogate 的同根形容词

entries.definition: to seize a position or power wrongfully
entries.definitionCN: 篡夺，侧重夺取既存职位，与 arrogate 义近

entries.definition: to take something for one's own use without permission
entries.definitionCN: 挪用、侵吞，与 arrogate 同表无据占有而更侧重物与款

entries.definition: to state that something belongs to one
entries.definitionCN: 声称拥有，中性词，不含「无据」的贬义

normalIntro.en: Split the word as ar- + rog- (ask) + -ate: asking for oneself.
normalIntro.cn: 把词拆成 ar- + rog-（求）+ -ate：为自己索求。

normal.en: arrogate to oneself is the classic pattern.
normal.cn: 经典用法是 arrogate to oneself（擅自揽权）。

normal.en: Same root family: abrogate, interrogate, prerogative.
It is formal; ordinary speech uses claim or seize.
normal.cn: 属书面语，口语常用 claim 或 seize。

normal.en: Passive is common: powers were arrogated to the center.
normal.cn: 常见被动：权力被擅归中央。

abstract.en: See a hand sliding a scepter off another man's desk into its own bag.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把权杖从他人桌上悄悄滑进自己包里。

abstract.en: Picture a nameplate changed overnight on an office door.
abstract.cn: 想象办公室门牌一夜之间被换掉。

abstract.en: Feel the coldness of taking what was never offered.
abstract.cn: 感受拿走从未被给予之物的凉意。

examples.en: The emergency committee arrogated powers never voted to it.
examples.cn: 紧急委员会攫取了从未经表决授予的权力。

examples.en: He arrogated to himself the final say in all matters.
examples.cn: 他把一切事务的最终决定权都揽到了自己手里。

examples.en: The sect arrogated divine honors to its leader.
examples.cn: 该教派妄称其领袖拥有神圣尊荣。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿若·给特」——阿若没跟任何人商量，径自把公章「给」自己「特批」使用，正是僭取。

root: 拉丁语 ad-（向）+ rogare（请求）→ arrogare（自取）→ arrogatus → 英语 arrogate；同根词 abrogate、interrogate、prerogative、surrogate。

sensesIntro.en: From seizing rights for oneself to wrongly attributing honors to others.
sensesIntro.cn: 由为自己攫取权利延伸到把荣誉谬托于他人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: seizing a scepter that was never offered
core.cn: 核心意象：拿走从未被授予的权杖

branches.cn: 未经授予而攫取的权力

intro.en: The rogare family attaches different prefixes to change direction of asking.
intro.cn: rogare 词族通过不同前缀改变「求」的方向。

latinIntro.en: Each verb keeps the core sense of formal demanding in Roman usage.
latinIntro.cn: 每个动词都保留罗马用法中「正式索求」的核心义。
